title: Icons order gets reshuffled after restarting plasmashell
line: Pinned apps in the Icons-only Task Manager keep their order after plasmashell restarts.
explanation: At startup the Task Manager's model gets the open windows before the panel sets its launcher list, so windows are first placed without knowing their pinned positions. When the launcher list arrives, the manual sort map is recomputed correctly, but the proxy model is never told to re-sort, so the existing rows keep their stale order until some later change (a new window, a title change) moves them. setLauncherList() now does what requestAddLauncher() already does in manual launch-in-place sorting: update the sort map and force a re-sort.

commits.message:
libtaskmanager: re-sort tasks when the launcher list is set

When plasmashell starts, windows are sorted before the launcher list is
loaded; setting it updated the sort map but the model never re-sorted,
so pinned apps showed up in the wrong order until something changed.

BUG: 505522

patches.diff:
From bc1aca460be9f0e0e8ec944f2017359408f1ab5f Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: =?UTF-8?q?Niccol=C3=B2=20Venerandi?= <niccolo@venerandi.com>
Date: Sat, 21 Nov 2026 10:28:16 +0100
Subject: [PATCH] libtaskmanager: re-sort tasks when the launcher list is set

When plasmashell starts, windows are sorted before the launcher list is
loaded; setting it updated the sort map but the model never re-sorted,
so pinned apps showed up in the wrong order until something changed.

BUG: 505522
---
 libtaskmanager/tasksmodel.cpp | 5 +++++
 1 file changed, 5 insertions(+)

diff --git a/libtaskmanager/tasksmodel.cpp b/libtaskmanager/tasksmodel.cpp
index fd6246a363..642db726c2 100644
--- a/libtaskmanager/tasksmodel.cpp
+++ b/libtaskmanager/tasksmodel.cpp
@@ -1394,6 +1394,11 @@ void TasksModel::setLauncherList(const QStringList &launchers)
     d->initLauncherTasksModel();
     d->launcherTasksModel->setLauncherList(launchers);
     d->launchersEverSet = true;
+
+    if (d->sortMode == SortManual && (d->launchInPlace || !d->separateLaunchers)) {
+        d->updateManualSortMap();
+        d->forceResort();
+    }
 }
 
 bool TasksModel::requestAddLauncher(const QUrl &url)
-- 
2.53.0

media.caption: Master, two plasmashell restarts: pinned Konsole, Dolphin, System Settings, System Monitor come back as Dolphin, Konsole, System Monitor, System Settings
With the fix, three restarts: Konsole, Dolphin, System Settings, System Monitor, then the unpinned XTerm, every time

review.text: Solid root-cause fix in libtaskmanager: calling updateManualSortMap() and forceResort() in TasksModel::setLauncherList() mirrors requestAddLauncher() and requestRemoveLauncher() directly below it and ensures the proxy view re-sorts once launchers arrive after initial window population. The before/after screenshots across multiple plasmashell restarts clearly prove pinned order is preserved, and interactions with drag-reordering and syncLaunchers() remain sound.
